# ligo_source (Resource)

A source: a set of workloads, named by a SPIFFE ID regex. Every change is a change request that the provider files once and waits for; it never approves one. A person who may not decide waits for an approver (approval_timeout in the provider).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The workloads of a pipeline. Owned by this automation (the lock): only it
# changes the source; a person who tries is refused with 409 resource-managed.
resource "ligo_source" "ledger_ci" {
  name         = "ledger-ci"
  display_name = "Ledger CI"
  trust_domain = "prod.lab"
  svid_regex   = "^spiffe://prod\\.lab/ns/fin/sa/ledger-ci$"

  labels = {
    team = "fin"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name; a new name is a new resource.
- `svid_regex` (String) The SPIFFE ID regex; an update may only narrow it, and ligo refuses a widening.
- `trust_domain` (String) The trust domain of the SPIFFE IDs it matches.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What it is.
- `display_name` (String) A name for people.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether this automation owns it (the lock): only the owner then changes it. Default: the provider's managed. false, on one that is managed, is the owner's release.
- `sample_spiffe_ids` (List of String) SPIFFE IDs the regex must match, checked by ligo.
- `state` (String) ACTIVE (the default) or DEPRECATED (no new bindings). Removal retires it.
- `visibility` (String) Who may see it in the catalog: PUBLIC, PRIVATE or SELECTED. Default: ligo's.
- `visible_to` (List of String) With SELECTED, the jurisdiction patterns that may see it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The name.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction, derived from the regex.
- `last_change_request` (String) The ID of the last change request the provider filed or waited for.
- `managed_by` (String) The SPIFFE ID of the automation that owns it; null when nobody does.
- `revision` (Number) The revision; an update names it, and ligo refuses a stale one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name. The first plan after the import shows what the configuration changes.
terraform import ligo_source.ledger_ci ledger-ci
```
